title: Pezeshkian: Iran Will Honor Nuclear Deal If US Returns to Agreement
text:
"Pezeshkian: Iran Will Honor Nuclear Deal If US Returns to Agreement  "

""
"Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian stated during a meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin that his country remains committed to the nuclear agreement it originally signed, and would uphold its obligations if the United States also returns to the accord.  "

""Our nation stands strong against the United States and the Israeli regime, and will continue to resist firmly if they persist," Pezeshkian said.  "

""We are committed to the same agreement we signed. If America returns to that agreement, we will also act accordingly," he added.  "

"The Iranian president emphasized that Tehran has sought nothing beyond its legitimate national rights under the deal, and that this remains its objective. He also stressed that the United States "cannot impose illegal demands on our country.
